subject: general
question: In which country is the Ural Industrial Region located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Ural Industrial Region**

__
 
• The Ura**ls are a mountain range in western Russia that runs from north to south.**
 
• It geographically** separates Asia and Europe.**
 
• The Ural Industrial Region is **located in Russia.**
 
• It is considered a part of the Eurasian Steppe.
 
• **The border between Europe and Asia runs along the eastern side of the Ural Mountains.**
 
• **The Urals lie mostly within Russia, but also include a small part of northwestern Kazakhstan.**
 
• It is not a historical, official entity, it has borders overlapping neighboring regions of the Western Volga and Eastern Siberia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Northern Ural Range**

 
• It starts from the Gulf of Kara and extends in the south-west up to 64 degrees north latitude.
 
• There are many clear chains found in this.
 
• This mountain range is rocky, rough and more sloping towards the southeast and less sloping towards the swamps of European Russia.

**Middle Ural Range**

 
• Its width is about 125 km.
 
• There are iron, copper and gold mines here.
 
• The Middle Ural is bordered by the Denezhkin Kamen (4,908 ft) to the north.

**Southern Ural Range**

 
• It is divided into three parallel chains extending north-east and south-west.
 
• To the south there is a plateau area of ​​about 1,500 feet high in which deep valleys of rivers are found.
 
• This region extends to the Bolga.
